d: Tyoharon ka sijan aate hi bajaron men mithaiyon ki mang teji se barh jati hai. lekin mithaiyon ki barhti mang ke sath hi nakli aur milavti khady padarthon ka khatra bhi barhne lagta hai. khaskar dilli-ensiaar men, jahan deshbhar se bari matra men khoya, panir aur dusri khady samagri pahunchti hai. aise men saval hai ki tyoharon par aap apne ghar jis mithaee ko lekar ja rahe hain vah sehat ke lie surakshit bhi hai ya nahin?
